text_construction: nonempty [TAG] value fields joined by one space; first 1200 characters
byte_policy: UTF-8 errors=ignore; truncate bytes; uint8 + 1; zero padding; int64

UNK_policy.behavior: unknown and empty categorical values map to UNK; never extend vocabulary

null_handling_policy.strings: strip whitespace; None/NaN and case-insensitive nan,none,null,nat,[null] become empty
null_handling_policy.numeric: missing column or pd.to_numeric(errors=coerce) missing value becomes 0
null_handling_policy.validator: reject missing/invalid required timestamps; report numeric parse errors; allow nullable category values

timezone_policy.reason: reference code does not explicitly normalize timezone

delta_sec_policy: per-stream timestamp diff; clip lower=0; fillna=0 before training split

session_stream_identity_policy.required_future_policy: user_id only for higher-level trajectory; no local feature or stream identity
session_stream_identity_policy.session_mapping_observed: session_id preferred over id; empty keys/users removed; duplicate key keep=last

input_data_policy: evidence/enrichment/export only; excluded from model features
ground_truth_policy: evaluation only; excluded from all model inputs and recovery

schema_validation_policy.sessions_required: user_id and either session_id or id
schema_validation_policy.category_oov: report only; map to UNK later
schema_validation_policy.note: New input validation is stricter than the historical notebook for IDs and timestamps.
